_comment: Local CI config (BNB-TOOLS T28). Every key is optional; a missing ci/config.json degrades to the defaults below. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. Unknown keys are an error: a mistyped key silently ignored would mean the check you think is running is not the check running.
_doc_counts: Counts to record, each with an optional assertion. Kinds: files (recursive count under path matching pattern, default *), dirs (immediate subdirs of path), lines (lines in the file at path), matches (regex matches in the file at path). expected/min/max turn a count into a gate; without one the count is recorded only and always passes.
_mode_check: Check that every named executable carries its exec bit on disk. Default true.
_status_file: Verdict file at the repo root. Default CI-STATUS.md.
_suite_command: The suite command, as a list or a single string. Default when tests/ exists: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests. When tests/ does not exist and no suite_command is set, the suite check SKIPs honestly instead of failing.
_suite_count_pattern: Regex with one group, run over the suite log to find the test count; the last match wins. Default: Ran (\d+) tests?
_suite_timeout: Seconds before the suite is killed and marked FAIL. Default 280 (the J1 value).
_tmp_base: Where throwaway work dirs live. Default: $LOCAL_CI_TMP, then ~/workspace/tmp when it exists (the sandbox /tmp is a small tmpfs and a suite run can fill it), else the system temp dir.
_zip: Build a throwaway Release-shaped zip and verify its stored modes. Default true. Set false for repos with nothing to pack (docs-only repos).
_zip_exclude_dirs: Dirs skipped by the zip build, the repo-size count, and files doc counts. Default: __pycache__, .git, .venv, node_modules, .forge.
_zip_exclude_suffixes: Filename suffixes skipped the same way. Default: .pyc, .pyo, .zip (the check zip is a throwaway; nesting a Release zip inside it adds nothing).
_zip_executable_globs: Globs that also ship executable (matched against the path and the basename). Default: *.sh, *.desktop. Glob-matched files are NOT checked on disk: a *.sh invoked only via `sh file.sh` needs no exec bit, and the zip stores 100755 for it either way.
_zip_executables: Root-relative paths that ship with the exec bit. Default: run.sh, install.sh, browser-setup.sh, install-gui.py, uninstall.sh (T1's list). Names listed here are REQUIRED: missing is a failure. Default-list names that are absent are fine.
_zip_executables_file: A manifest file in the repo (one root-relative path per line, # comments), the Forge Browser EXECUTABLES.txt shape. Names from it are required and merge with zip_executables. Default: none.
_zip_top: Top folder name inside the throwaway zip. Default: the repo dir name.
